The '''Deluxe Sun Room''' was an [[Sun room|artificial environment room]] manufactured by [[zZip Product Concepts Limited]]. It was designed to approximate the natural sunlight of a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in order to help stave off the depression that beings felt after being under artificial light sources for an extended period.
